working_geometry_plain: The working L2 geometry is a finite L/R Weyl sheet-cover readout carried by PEPS3D anchors. Finite spinor-derived site densities are lifted to two sheet cells over the same K=(V,E,F,C) carrier. Each sheet carries its own Hamiltonian sign, ladder action, projector ownership, order-sensitive local channel action, and local L/R sheet-pair entropy cut. This is still a local finite layer lego, not layer stacking, Hopf/fibration admission, terrain, flux, Axis0, physics, or final manifold evidence.
finite_map: L2_WK : (K=(V,E,F,C), finite boundary site anchors v, finite spinor densities rho_v, sheet s in {L,R}, H_s in {+H0,-H0}, finite ladder/projector operators, finite action paths H->Ladder and Ladder->H) -> finite sheet signatures, mirror/non-equivalence gaps, order-gap readouts, and local QIT entropy/cut readouts
domain: finite PEPS3D carriers K for shapes (2,2,2), (4,2,2), (4,4,2), (4,4,4); finite anchors V,E,F,C; finite spinors {|0>,|1>,|+>,|->}; finite spinor-derived densities rho_v; sheets {L,R}; finite sheet operators {H_L,H_R,L_L,L_R,P_L,P_R}; finite action paths {H->Ladder, Ladder->H}; PEPS3D bond_dim=2
codomain_or_output: finite L/R sheet signatures, sheet-projector probabilities, sheet action order gaps, mirror/non-equivalence readouts, local von Neumann/Renyi2/MI/conditional/coherent entropy readouts, tool-ablation statuses, and 8/16/32/64 stress summaries
